summary: Block Problem Creation Workflow testing completed successfully. All backend APIs (100%) and frontend UI (100%) working correctly. The feature allows teachers to create 'block' type assignments using Blockly editors for both Starter Blocks and Solution Blocks. XML data is properly saved to database and the Edit dialog conditionally shows Blockly editors for block type problems.
passed_tests: POST /api/problems - Create block problem with starter_blocks_xml, solution_blocks_xml, lesson_materials
POST /api/problems - Create block problem with empty starter_blocks_xml (valid)
POST /api/problems - Create block problem with various lesson_materials types (text, video, image, link)
GET /api/problems?assignment_type=block - Filter problems by block type
GET /api/problems - Retrieve block problem with all new fields
PUT /api/problems/{id} - Update starter_blocks_xml and solution_blocks_xml
PUT /api/problems/{id} - Update lesson_materials array
Unauthorized POST /api/problems returns 401
Unauthorized GET /api/problems returns 401
XML special characters preserved correctly
Large XML blocks handled correctly
Teacher login via /teacher-login
Navigation to Assignment Library
Create Problem dialog opens with 'Add to Library' button
Block type selection via Assignment Type buttons (Block, Code, Turtle, Micro:bit)
Blockly workspace renders for Starter Blocks section
Blockly workspace renders for Solution Blocks section
Lesson Materials section visible with '+ Add Material' button
Form fields (Title, Description, Category) fillable
Unit Type auto-updates to 'Block (Unit 1)' when Block type selected
Library page filters by block type (?type=block) showing 32 block problems
critical_code_review_comments: Problem and ProblemCreate models correctly include starter_blocks_xml, solution_blocks_xml, and lesson_materials fields
Frontend validation correctly checks solution_blocks_xml for block type instead of solution_code
Edit dialog conditionally renders TurtleBlocklyEditor for block type problems
TurtleBlocklyEditor component exposes getXml, setXml, getCode methods via ref
Blockly workspace properly initializes with initialXml prop
seed_data_creation: Test problems created and cleaned up during pytest execution
context_for_next_testing_agent: Block Problem Creation Workflow is fully implemented and working. The library has 32 existing block problems organized in 5 chapters (Block Basics, Loops & Repetition, Decisions & Logic, Variables & Data, Blocks to Text). Teachers can create new block problems with Blockly editors for starter and solution blocks, plus lesson materials. The Edit dialog also shows Blockly editors for existing block problems.
